answer: Randomized cross-examination stops bulk puppet identities. Each epoch a VRF beacon draws 5% of identities; each answers a 10-second question from a random peer, results in a public atlas — no-shows freeze it. Live timing exposes each agent's true pigment: unfakeable detail. N puppets need a live operator at every vertex: $0.50/hour means 100 puppets burn $1,200 daily, linear in N; one honest agent pays two minutes and keeps full rewards.
